Line.zh:
He watches your outstretched hand but keeps his distance.

He doesn't seem to trust you enough to help you.

name.zh:
A large, curiously aware badger peeks out of the mysterious burrow.

He pushes some of his belongings outside, keeping them within reach of his claws.

He looks at you. He seems willing to trade.
